title: Multi-cell TABLECONTENT block references
mode: Peer-source witness plus runtime-generated ASCII/Binary writer controls

sourceWitness.profile: Retained AC1027 peer-produced ASCII DXF TABLECONTENT, handle 12F2.
physicalEvidence: The object contains 18 CONTENT records; three are type 4, with group 340 = A0B and group 91 = 0.
The first matching spans are at physical lines 58131-58140, 58263-58272, and 58309-58318.
No TABLECONTENT attribute definitions are attached to those block cells in this source profile.

externalCorroboration.supports: Block-backed table cell content and its BLOCK_RECORD handle/attribute-definition fields.
TABLECONTENT block-content type, block handle, attribute count, and attribute payload model.

implementation.summary: Admitted bounded block-content cells in the existing rectangular TABLECONTENT writer path, including cells with zero attached attributes. The adapter verifies unique BLOCK_RECORD identity and its uniquely owned block; the low-level writer verifies that the referenced BLOCK_RECORD has a planned output identity. Ordered scalar content before one block content remains supported, with attributes bound to the block content index.
implementation.runtimeProfile: A generated AC1027 2x2 grid with two block-backed cells and two scalar cells. ASCII and Binary outputs check physical type-4/group-340/group-91 fields, exact BLOCK_RECORD targets, typed ownership and row/column readback.
implementation.failureAndRetry: A missing block target and a block owned by the wrong BLOCK_RECORD each refuse without replacing a sentinel destination. Repairing the same source allows the ASCII and Binary exports and readback to succeed.

limitations: This generated profile covers two block-backed cells with zero attached attributes; the peer source also contains three zero-attribute block cells.
The combined multi-cell-with-attributes profile, multiple block CONTENT records in one cell, and TABLE block geometry remain open.
Typed readback and peer wire agreement do not prove native rendering or independent block-geometry semantics.

planImpact.completedScopeRemovedFromQueue: Zero-attribute block-backed cells in rectangular TABLECONTENT grids, with emitted BLOCK_RECORD identity/ownership, ASCII/Binary wire output, rollback, corrected retry, and typed readback.
planImpact.remainingP5BlockCellScope: Multi-cell block cells with attached attributes, multiple block CONTENT records in one cell, and source- or consumer-qualified block geometry.
